spell.arcanes_oublies.gold_bolt.guide: Hurl a spinning ingot of gold. It gilds what it strikes, throws out a spray of coins and ricochets on to the nearest enemy in sight.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gilded_chains.guid: Chains of gold burst out of the ground, pin your target in place and gild it, a little more every two seconds it stays bound.
death.attack.gold_magic.item: %1$s was turned to gold by %2$s using %3$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.goldfall.guide: The sun stone opens in the sky over the targeted spot and giant ingots of gold drop from it one after the other, crushing and gilding everything where they land, before melting into coins.
spell.arcanes_oublies.golden_spikes.guid: A wave of gold crystals bursts out of the ground in front of you, gilding and tossing your enemies into the air, and breaks in a crown of spikes at its end.
spell.arcanes_oublies.midas_curse.guide: Your target turns to gold from the feet up, slower and slower until it freezes into a golden statue that shatters, gilding those around it. The more coats of gold it already wears, the sooner it turns: gilded through, it turns at once.
spell.arcanes_oublies.aurum_blade.guide: A giant sword is forged from molten gold in the sky above your target and plunges into it, gilding everything around. The planted blade then rings out an aftershock before melting into coins.
spell.arcanes_oublies.molten_torrent.gui: Pour a stream of molten gold that burns and gilds your enemies and leaves pools behind. The pools cool into solid gold that holds the feet of those standing in it and climbs up their legs.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gilded_armor.guide: Liquid gold flows up your body and hardens into armor: more armor, part of every hit you take goes back to the attacker, and whoever strikes you hand to hand comes away gilded.
spell.arcanes_oublies.golden_sentinels.g: Golden knights crowned with the sun rise out of molten gold to guard you. Every blow they strike gilds your enemies. Cast again to send them away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sun_of_eldorado.gu: Raise the jewelled sun stone of Eldorado above you. Its beams burn and gild every nearby enemy, turning those gilded through into statues, then it collapses in a supernova of gold.
spell.arcanes_oublies.golden_dragon.guid: A giant sun blazes up in the sky above you and the Golden Dragon of Eldorado pours out of it to hunt your enemies: it breathes molten gold, coils round its prey and roars, dives through them, and gilds everything it hurts. Cast again to send it away.
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.golden_drag: %1$s was gilded and devoured by %2$s's Golden Dragon
ui.arcanes_oublies.dragon_coil: Coils Round Its Prey and Gilds It
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.midas_curse: %1$s was turned to gold by %2$s and shattered
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.gilded_armo: %1$s hit %2$s's golden armor a little too hard
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.sun_of_eldo: %1$s was burned away by %2$s's Sun of Eldorado
spell.arcanes_oublies.blast_orb.guide: Hurl an orb of unstable energy that bursts into a double shock wave on impact.
spell.arcanes_oublies.chain_detonation.g: An explosion strikes your target, then leaps from enemy to enemy, each blast bigger than the last.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sigils_of_ruin.gui: Burn glowing runes into the ground. An enemy stepping on one sets it off, and the blast sets off the sigils next to it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.detonation_wave.gu: Strike the ground: rings of explosions roll outward around you like a wave of fire.
spell.arcanes_oublies.implosion.guide: Open a point of black light that drags nearby enemies into it, contracts, then detonates in a blinding white sphere.
spell.arcanes_oublies.volatile_brand.gui: Burn a glowing mark into your target. Every hit it takes charges the mark, and the fifth one makes it explode.
spell.arcanes_oublies.blast_leap.guide: An explosion under your feet throws you into the sky. You dive back down and your landing sets off a second blast. No fall damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.cluster_barrage.gu: Launch a big shell into the sky above your target. It bursts into eight glowing sub-charges that rain down and explode one after the other.
spell.arcanes_oublies.reactive_shield.gu: Wrap yourself in a crackling shell. When you are hit, it takes part of the blow and explodes, throwing your attackers back. Three explosions.
spell.arcanes_oublies.cataclysm.guide: Rise into the air while a sphere of energy swells above you, then explodes in a giant dome of white light ringed by a crown of explosions.
death.attack.explosion_magic.item: %1$s was blown to pieces by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.blast_orb: %1$s was blown up by %2$s's Blast Orb
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.sigils_of_r: %1$s stepped on one of %2$s's Sigils of Ruin
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.detonation_: %1$s was swept away by %2$s's Detonation Wave
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.reactive_sh: %1$s hit %2$s's Reactive Shield and paid for it
spell.arcanes_oublies.page_storm.guide: A whirlwind of runic pages wraps around your target and slashes it again and again.
spell.arcanes_oublies.living_ink.guide: A wave of living ink spreads out in front of you. Black hands rise from it, seize every enemy it reaches and blind them.
A colossal grimoire opens above you. Its pages form a dome over the area and every enemy under it is marked with a rune that explodes.
death.attack.book_magic: %1$s was written out of the story
death.attack.book_magic.player: %1$s was written out of the story by %2$s
death.attack.book_magic.item: %1$s was written out of the story by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.the_final_c: %1$s reached the end of %2$s's Final Chapter
spell.arcanes_oublies.razor_pages.guide: Throw a fan of pages with glowing razor edges. Each one slices through enemies before tearing apart.
spell.arcanes_oublies.tome_of_judgment.g: A giant book opens in the sky over the targeted spot, comes down and claps shut on it, crushing every enemy caught between its pages.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bookmark.guide: Plant a glowing bookmark where you stand. Cast the spell again before it fades to return to it in a shower of pages.
spell.arcanes_oublies.seal_of_silence.gu: Stamp a sealed rune on your target: it cannot cast spells until the seal breaks.
Summon flying grimoires that fight by your side, biting your enemies and spitting small spells at them. Cast again to send them away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.word_of_power.guid: Speak a giant runic word. It takes shape in letters of fire in front of you, then explodes forward in a cone of flame.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rewrite.guide: Rewrite your own story: every harmful effect on you is erased and you recover some health.
spell.arcanes_oublies.paper_cranes.guide: Glowing origami cranes take flight around you, then dive at your enemies and burst into paper confetti.
spell.arcanes_oublies.quill_of_fate.guid: A giant spectral quill writes a line of ink on the ground ahead of you. The writing erupts into rune pillars that fling enemies into the air.
spell.arcanes_oublies.parchment_aegis.gu: Pages circle you like armour. Each one stops a projectile, or softens a blow and flies back at the attacker.
ui.arcanes_oublies.silenced: You are silenced: you cannot cast spells
ui.arcanes_oublies.bookmark_other_world: Your bookmark is in another world
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.razor_pages: %1$s was cut to ribbons by %2$s's Razor Pages
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.tome_of_jud: %1$s was judged and crushed by %2$s's Tome of Judgment
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.word_of_pow: %1$s was burned away by %2$s's Word of Power
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.quill_of_fa: %1$s had their fate written by %2$s's Quill of Fate
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.parchment_a: %1$s struck %2$s's Parchment Aegis and was cut down
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_rats.guide: Summon a rat of sky-blue mana. Small and fast, it bites whatever you fight. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_piranha.guide: Summon a piranha of mana in the water you look at, or the nearest water around you. It lives only in water: it darts through it, follows you along the water and bites your enemies in the water or at its edge, its teeth of light flashing, harder with each bite in a row on the same prey (up to double). Stranded on land, it flops and fades. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_dromedary.gui: Summon a saddled dromedary of mana that you can ride (right click), dash included. A second rider can climb on behind you. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_serpent.guide: Summon a serpent of mana that slithers after your enemies; its bite poisons and slows. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_crows.guide: Summon a crow of mana that circles above you and swoops down to peck at your enemies. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_fox.guide: Summon a fox of mana, very fast, whose bite leaves your enemies bleeding. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_wolf.guide: Summon a heavy, maned wolf of mana that runs down your enemies and bites hard. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_butterfly.gui: Summon a butterfly of mana that flutters around you and heals you (you only) by three hearts every ten seconds. It never fights. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_kangaroo.guid: Summon a kangaroo of mana as tall as you that boxes your enemies: heavy punches that throw them back, and every third blow a fury of punches. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mana_falcon.guide: A great falcon of mana carries you off: it flies where you look, fast (sneak to get off, right click to climb back on). Without you it circles above you. Cast again to send it away.
ui.arcanes_oublies.fury_punch: A Fury of Punches Every %s Blows
death.attack.errethys_magic.item: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's mana using %3$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.paper_tempest.guid: A tornado of pages rises where you look and follows your eyes. It drags enemies in, cuts and blinds them, swallows arrows, then flings everything away when it blows out.
spell.arcanes_oublies.flying_stack.guide: A pile of paper lifts you off the ground: fly where you look (forward to move, look up or down to climb or dive), sneak to get off and float down. Right click it to climb back on. Cast again to send it away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.origami_dragon.gui: A great sheet of paper folds itself into a dragon that hunts your enemies: it circles them, breathes a cone of razor-sharp paper and dives through them, then folds back into a sheet and bursts into confetti. Cast again to send it away.
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.paper_tempe: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's Paper Tempest
ui.arcanes_oublies.needs_water: There is no water nearby for the piranha
spell.arcanes_oublies.punch.guide: A step in and a straight punch with your whole body behind it: it hits the nearest enemy in front of you (3 blocks) hard and knocks it back. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.punch_flurry.guide: Feet planted, seven jabs in a second, left and right, at everyone in front of you, then a straight punch that sends them back. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.slash.guide: One fast diagonal cut, with a blade or the edge of your hand, through everyone in a wide arc in front of you. A blade adds part of its damage. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.slash_flurry.guide: Three cuts back and forth, then a wide level cut that pushes everyone back, all in a second. A blade adds part of its damage. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.dash.guide: A quick burst of 4 to 5 blocks the way you are already moving (back or sideways to dodge), else straight ahead. It stops dead, so it never carries further. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.leap.guide: A jump from both legs, 3 blocks high (6 at the highest level), keeping your run-up. Landing from it does not hurt. Feet on the ground only. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.scythe_reap.guide: Wind the scythe back, then sweep it low through everything in a wide half-circle in front of you (4.5 blocks), cutting at the legs: the victims are slowed. Long reach, slow wind-up. Hits with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.scythe_dance.guide: A slash in front of you, then a full spin with the scythe at arm's length that cuts everything all around you (4.5 blocks) and throws it back. Hits with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sword_rising_cut.g: An upward cut that lifts the enemies in front of you off their feet (about a block and a half), open to a follow-up. Hits with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sword_lunge.guide: Spring forward about two blocks and drive the point straight ahead, through everyone on the line (3.5 blocks). Hits with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.dagger_stabs.guide: Three fast thrusts at the nearest enemy in front of you. Each one leaves it bleeding; the third deepens the wound. Hits with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.dagger_flank.guide: Dart around the enemy you face (up to 5 blocks away) to end up behind it, or at its side if there is no room, then stab: from behind it deals much more and leaves it bleeding. Hits with your weapon's damage.
ui.arcanes_oublies.needs_ground: You need your feet on the ground
ui.arcanes_oublies.no_target_near: No enemy close enough in front of you
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.sword_risin: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Rising Cut
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.dagger_flan: %1$s was stabbed in the back by %2$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.evade.guide: A big leap backward to get out of a fight: 6 to 8 blocks straight back from where you face, in a low arc, landing without a fall. Feet on the ground only. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rush.guide: Run at the enemy you are looking at (10 to 14 blocks away), steering after it as it moves, and stop right in front of it with a shoulder blow that staggers it. With no one in sight, a long low run straight ahead (7 blocks) that stops dead. Not magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.scythe_hook.guide: You bring the scythe down far in front of you so the blade hooks behind whoever stands there (up to 5.5 blocks away, a narrow cone), then drag it back: they are cut and pulled to your feet, a little slowed. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sword_disarm.guide: Your point binds the blade of the nearest enemy in front (3 blocks), turns it in a tight circle and flicks it out of their grip. A creature loses its weapon for a few seconds (it gets it back, nothing is dropped for good); a player keeps theirs but loses their grip as long: Weakness, a raised shield knocked aside, the item in hand unusable.
spell.arcanes_oublies.dagger_finisher.gu: The dagger turned point down in your fist and driven into the nearest enemy in front (2.8 blocks). It finishes off the wounded: 2.5 times the damage against one under a third of its health, 1.6 times against one bleeding, pinned or slowed. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
A flat two-handed swing at the head of the nearest enemy in front (3.2 blocks). It spins them round: they end up facing the other way (a player's view turns with them), dizzy and unsteady for a few seconds. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.hammer_quake.guide: You bring the hammer down into the ground in front of you with everything behind it. The shock runs through the ground: everyone standing within about 4 blocks is hurt (fully at the impact, half at the edge), thrown off their feet and slowed. Whoever is in the air escapes it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.hammer_ram.guide: The hammer held level in both hands and rammed straight into the nearest enemy in front (3 blocks) with a step in. It sends them flying back several blocks; slammed into a wall on the way, they take a second blow.
spell.arcanes_oublies.axe_cleave.guide: The axe raised over your head and chopped down hard on the nearest enemy in front (3.2 blocks). A raised shield does not stop it: the axe knocks it aside first (it cannot be raised again for 5 seconds), then bites. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.axe_throw.guide: You throw an axe overhand where you look, tumbling end over end. It falls like anything thrown and hits the first enemy in its way hard (you keep yours: it is a spare). Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.axe_sunder.guide: A slanting chop through the guard and armor of the nearest enemy in front (3.2 blocks). Its armor is split open: a quarter of its armor and toughness gone (half from level 4) for several seconds, and every piece it wears takes wear. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.spear_thrust.guide: The spear drawn back low in both hands and driven out full length with a step in, through everyone on the line up to 5 blocks ahead: the reach of a spear keeps the enemy at bay. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.spear_charge.guide: The spear couched low, you run straight ahead (about 7 blocks in half a second). The first enemy in the way is skewered hard and thrown back, and the charge stops there. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.spear_javelin.guid: A run-up stride and a spear (a spare) hurled where you look, fast and far. It goes through the first enemy and into the next, and the head stays in the wound: the struck are slowed. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.longsword_cut.guid: The longsword raised over your right shoulder in both hands and cut down on a slant, through everyone in front (3.6 blocks, a wide arc). The weight of it staggers them. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.longsword_sweep.gu: The longsword drawn back low on the right, then swept flat in a wide half circle with a step in, through everyone in front and to the sides (4 blocks), throwing them back. Strikes with your weapon's damage.
spell.arcanes_oublies.longsword_parry.gu: You raise the longsword in a guard for about a second. The first blow from in front is caught on the blade: a weapon blow (or a fighting move) does nothing, the attacker is thrown off balance (slowed, weakened) and gets the point straight back; an arrow or a thrown weapon is turned aside. A blade cannot parry magic.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bow_guided.guide: An arrow you steer with your eyes. For a few seconds after it leaves the bow, it bends its flight toward whatever you look at (up to 48 blocks away), without dropping; then it flies on like any arrow. A bow's Power adds to it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bow_volley.guide: Five arrows nocked together and loosed at once in a fan 40 degrees wide, where you look. Each hits for a share of the shot; a bow's Power adds to them.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bow_rain.guide: Arrows loosed high into the sky one after another, coming down a second later on the spot you looked at (up to 32 blocks away): a hail of arrows over a circle 3.5 blocks wide. Never on your allies.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crossbow_pierce.gu: A heavy bolt shot flat and very fast where you aim. It goes through 3 enemies and into a fourth (one more per level of Piercing on the crossbow), hitting each one hard.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crossbow_burst.gui: Three bolts shot one after another, a fifth of a second apart, each where you aim at that moment, so a moving target can be followed.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crossbow_harpoon.g: A barbed bolt on a rope, about 24 blocks long. If it bites into an enemy, you haul them in to your feet; if it bites into a wall, the rope hauls you there instead (and a fall after it does not hurt).
spell.arcanes_oublies.knife_throw.guide: One knife flicked overhand where you aim, fast and straight. It leaves the struck bleeding, and from far away (8 blocks or more) it finds a weak spot and hits harder.
spell.arcanes_oublies.knife_fan.guide: Your throwing hand sweeps across from right to left, letting five knives go one after another: they fly out in a fan 60 degrees wide.
spell.arcanes_oublies.knife_pin.guide: Crouched low, you fling a knife underhand at the feet of whoever you aim at. It pins a foot to the ground: no walking and no jumping for a few seconds.
ui.arcanes_oublies.hook_pull: Hooks and Pulls Enemies up to %s Blocks Away
ui.arcanes_oublies.wounded_bonus: x%s Against the Wounded (Bleeding, Pinned, Slowed)

death.attack.arcanes_oublies.dagger_fini: %1$s was given the coup de grâce by %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.hammer_quak: %1$s was crushed by the Earthshaker of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.hammer_ram: %1$s was rammed into the wall by %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.spear_charg: %1$s was skewered by the charge of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.spear_javel: %1$s was pierced by the javelin of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.bow_guided: %1$s was hunted down by the arrow of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.bow_rain: %1$s was caught in the arrow rain of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.knife_fan: %1$s was cut down by the knives of %2$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.crushing_meteor.gu: A rune circle opens in the sky over your target and marks the ground below. A burning meteor crashes into it, then a shockwave rolls out around the crater.
spell.arcanes_oublies.judgment_blade.gui: A giant blade of light rises over a long strip marked in front of you and comes down on it. A second later the strip erupts in pillars of light.
A rune circle stands up before you and charges while the strip ahead is marked, then fires a beam of energy down it for two seconds.
spell.arcanes_oublies.triple_nova.guide: Three circles of fire are marked around you: the inner disc bursts, then a ring, then a wider ring, one after another.
spell.arcanes_oublies.starfall.guide: Small circles of starlight are marked one after another around your target, and a star falls into each one in turn.
spell.arcanes_oublies.seismic_rift.guide: Strike the ground: a fissure is marked from your feet and cracks open stretch by stretch, throwing whoever stands on it into the air.
spell.arcanes_oublies.void_orb.guide: A great sphere of darkness rolls slowly along a marked path, hurting what touches it. At the end of the path it collapses, pulling everything in, then bursts.
spell.arcanes_oublies.cross_of_light.gui: A great cross is marked around your target and erupts in pillars of light, then a second cross, turned an eighth of a turn, erupts in its turn.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rune_prison.guide: A ring is marked around your target, then a wall of runes rises along it. Anyone not on your side who tries to cross it is hurt and thrown back.
spell.arcanes_oublies.last_judgment.guid: A giant rune circle opens in the sky and the whole arena around you is marked for destruction, with three small green shelters. Meteors fall while the sentence counts down, then the judgment strikes everything outside the shelters.
death.attack.boss_magic: %1$s was crushed by a boss's wrath
death.attack.boss_magic.player: %1$s was crushed by the wrath of %2$s
death.attack.boss_magic.item: %1$s was crushed by the wrath of %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.starfall: %1$s was struck by a star of %2$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.cross_of_li: %1$s was burned away by %2$s's Cross of Light
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.rune_prison: %1$s died against the walls of %2$s's prison
spell.arcanes_oublies.ward_rune.guide: Carve a circle of runes into the ground at your feet. A curtain of light rises from it, and your allies standing inside are shielded (Resistance) for as long as it glows.
A standing stone carved with orchid runes rises where you point. Every two seconds its runes pulse and heal your allies around it. Casting it again sends the old stone back into the ground.
spell.arcanes_oublies.edge_rune.guide: Carve a rune into your weapon and into those of the allies around you: for a while, every blow struck in close combat deals the rune's damage on top.
spell.arcanes_oublies.runic_path.guide: Carve a strip of rune tiles ahead of you. Allies walking on it run faster and jump higher.
spell.arcanes_oublies.runic_bulwark.guid: A wall of carved stone slabs bursts out of the ground in an arc before you. Nothing walks through it and arrows and spells stop against it, until it crumbles.
spell.arcanes_oublies.snare_rune.guide: Carve a small, barely glowing rune where you point. Once armed, the first enemy to step on it makes it burst into stone spikes that hurt, slow and throw up everyone around. Up to three at once.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rune_shards.guide: Hurl a fan of carved stone shards, their runes glowing. Each one goes through an enemy before shattering.
spell.arcanes_oublies.petrifying_rune.gu: A rune lights up under your target and stone climbs its legs: it can neither walk nor jump and the stone grinds at it. When the hold ends, the stone shatters and hurts it once more.
spell.arcanes_oublies.menhir_surge.guide: Strike the ground: a line of rune-carved menhirs bursts out one after another straight ahead, throwing up and hurting whatever stands on them.
spell.arcanes_oublies.circle_of_elders.g: Eight great runestones rise in a ring around you. Every second your allies inside are healed and shielded, while runic lightning leaps from the stones to the enemies inside.
ui.arcanes_oublies.path_speed: Speed %s and Jump Boost for Allies on It
ui.arcanes_oublies.arc_damage: %s Damage per Second to up to %s Enemies Inside
ui.arcanes_oublies.heal_per_second: %s Healing per Second to Allies Inside
death.attack.rune_magic.player: %1$s was undone by the runes of %2$s
death.attack.rune_magic.item: %1$s was undone by the runes of %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.petrifying_: %1$s shattered with the stone of %2$s's rune
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.circle_of_e: %1$s was struck down in %2$s's Circle of the Elders
spell.arcanes_oublies.fire_glyph.guide: Trace the glyph of fire in the air before you: as soon as it is written, it looses its flame comets one after another where you look, setting what they hit on fire. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.frost_glyph.guide: Trace the snowflake glyph: it shatters into a fan of ice needles, each going through an enemy and chilling everything it touches. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.storm_glyph.guide: Trace the glyph of the storm: lightning cracks out of it into the enemy you are looking at, then leaps on from enemy to enemy. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.tide_glyph.guide: Trace the glyph of the tide: a wall of water pours out of it and rolls ahead in a wide arc, throwing enemies back and putting out fires. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gale_glyph.guide: Trace the glyph of the wind: a gust bursts out of it in a narrow arc and throws the enemies in its way into the air. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.stone_glyph.guide: Trace the glyph of stone: it hardens into a boulder hurled where you look, which bursts on landing and strikes everyone around. Each hit inscribes its element's mark on the victim; a glyph of another element striking the mark sets off their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.elemental_seal.gui: The six element glyphs are written in a ring around you and turn with you. One after another, they loose their bolt at the nearest enemy, so the six elements follow each other on whatever comes close and set off their reactions.
spell.arcanes_oublies.elemental_script.g: Write a line of glyphs along the ground towards where you look, each in the next element. Each one erupts as soon as it is written: an enemy caught between two of them suffers both, and their reaction.
spell.arcanes_oublies.glyph_resonance.gu: Every mark you have inscribed on the enemies around answers at once: each one bursts on its bearer, and its element splashes onto the enemies beside it, setting off their own marks' reactions.
spell.arcanes_oublies.primordial_glyph.g: Write the great glyph across the sky above you: a ring of gold, the six element glyphs on it, the star joining them. Then, round the ring, each element hurls its bolt down on the enemies below, and their reactions go off on every side.
death.attack.glyph_magic.player: %1$s was written out of existence by %2$s
death.attack.glyph_magic.item: %1$s was written out of existence by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.primordial_: %1$s was struck down by %2$s's primordial glyph
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_throw.guide: Fling a soul token where you look: it hurts what it hits and stays where it lands. Cast again while it lies there (instant and free) to teleport to it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_wave.guide: A wave of soul tokens surges out of the ground and rolls ahead of you, striking and throwing up every enemy on its way.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_storm.guide: A whirlwind of soul tokens rises around you and moves with you: it slashes the enemies inside every half second and knocks enemy shots out of the air.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_ricochet.gui: A soul token shot at an enemy bounces on to the next one, and the next.
spell.arcanes_oublies.coin_flip.guide: Toss a soul token and let it decide. Heads: it flies at the enemy you look at and hits it twice as hard (with no one in sight, Strength for 10 seconds). Tails: it heals you and wraps you in Absorption.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_aegis.guide: Soul tokens turn around you: each one catches a blow or a shot meant for you (no damage) and flies back at whoever struck. Falls and fire go through.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_rain.guide: Soul tokens rain down for a few seconds on the spot you point at, each bursting where it lands.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_mines.guide: Scatter a fan of soul tokens on the ground ahead. Once armed (a second), each bursts when an enemy comes near, hurting and slowing those around. Up to nine at once.
spell.arcanes_oublies.soul_tribute.guide: Pull a soul token out of each enemy around you, which hurts them; the tokens fly to you and heal you as they arrive.
spell.arcanes_oublies.token_hand.guide: Dozens of soul tokens fly in from every side and come together into a giant hand over the enemy you look at. It seizes it, lifts it, crushing it, then slams it into the ground, throwing everyone around. With no one in sight, the hand slams the spot you point at.
ui.arcanes_oublies.token_teleport: Cast again within %s to teleport to the token

death.attack.arcanes_oublies.token_storm: %1$s was cut down in %2$s's token storm
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.soul_tribut: %1$s paid tribute to %2$s with their soul
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.token_hand: %1$s was crushed in %2$s's Hand of Souls
spell.arcanes_oublies.copper_spikes.guid: Strike the ground: a wedge of jagged copper spikes bursts out ahead of you, row after row, impaling and throwing up the enemies standing there and leaving them bleeding.
spell.arcanes_oublies.ancient_pillar.gui: A mossy column of old copper bursts out of the ground under the enemy you look at (or where you point) and throws it high into the air.
spell.arcanes_oublies.toppling_wall.guid: A stretch of ancient rampart, five blocks wide, bursts up before you, sways, and falls flat forward, crushing and slowing everyone it lands on.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rust_bolt.guide: Hurl a clot of rust flakes at an enemy: its armour rusts, protecting less and wearing away for as long as the rust lasts.
spell.arcanes_oublies.strangling_vines.g: Moss spreads under the enemy you look at and vines climb it, holding it in place (no walking, no jumping) and squeezing it every second. From level 3 they seize the enemies next to it too.
spell.arcanes_oublies.moss_spores.guide: A carpet of flowering moss spreads where you point and breathes out spores: every half second the enemies on it choke (hurt, poisoned and slowed).
spell.arcanes_oublies.colonnade.guide: A ring of eight ancient columns bursts out of the ground around you, hurting every enemy near and throwing them away.
spell.arcanes_oublies.ancient_lightning_: A tall column of green copper crowned with a lightning rod rises where you point. For a while it draws lightning down on the nearest enemy around it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.ancient_bell.guide: A great bell of bronze gone green drops out of the sky on the enemy you look at. Those under it are crushed and dazed by its toll; those around are hurt and thrown back.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sunken_temple.guid: The ruins of an ancient temple rise around the enemy you look at: a ring of mossy copper columns that shuts it in while rubble rains down, then topples inward all at once, burying everything inside.
death.attack.verdigris_magic.item: %1$s was buried under %2$s's ancient copper using %3$s
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.ancient_lig: %1$s was struck by the lightning of %2$s's rod
spell.arcanes_oublies.brick_bolt.guide: A sigil burns under you and stone bricks tear themselves out of the ground at your shoulders, their mortar glowing like embers. One after another they are hurled at the enemy you look at, striking hard and bursting. More bricks at higher levels.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rising_wall.guide: A crenellated wall of real stone bricks builds itself ahead of you, block after block flying up out of the ground, its mortar glowing. It is solid: nobody walks through it and shots break on it. Wider and higher at higher levels; when its time is up it crumbles and the ground is left as it was.
spell.arcanes_oublies.brick_rain.guide: A sigil burns on the spot you point at; above it a vortex of bricks gathers, turning, then pours its bricks down on the circle, the first right in the middle, each bursting where it lands.
spell.arcanes_oublies.wall_burst.guide: A wall builds itself before you; its mortar heats white-hot and the wall shakes, then it blows apart forward: a cone of flying bricks hurts and throws back every enemy in it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.mortar.guide: Lob a lump of bricks high onto the spot you point at; a sigil burns where it will land. It bursts there, hurting, slowing and scattering the enemies around.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crushing_walls.gui: Two walls build themselves on either side of the enemy you look at, then slam together on it, faster and faster, face to face: it is crushed and dazed, and both walls burst into flying bricks.
spell.arcanes_oublies.brick_cage.guide: A closed cell of real stone bricks builds itself around the enemy you look at, course after course, then the lid. Walled in, in the dark, it is hurt and stays shut in until the cell crumbles. The cell is sized to its prisoner.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rampart_charge.gui: A great crenellated wall builds itself before you and charges ahead, ploughing the ground and sweeping the enemies before it, then crashes and blows apart, throwing them further.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bastion.guide: A square keep of real stone bricks builds itself around you, running round as it rises: crenellated walls three blocks out on every side and a taller tower at each corner. Nobody gets in, no shot gets through, and you resist damage inside. It crumbles when its time is up.
spell.arcanes_oublies.fallen_citadel.gui: Channel for two seconds while a great sigil spreads under you. Then a fortress rises around you: a round wall of real bricks nine blocks out, built all the way round, and eight towers bursting up along it, braziers burning on top. For ten seconds the towers shell every enemy within 26 blocks, one tower after another, while you stand unshaken behind them. Then the whole fortress blows apart outward, throwing back everything around.
spell.arcanes_oublies.brick_quake.guide: You stamp and the ground answers in three waves running out from your feet. Behind each ring, columns of stone bricks burst up out of the ground one after another, leaning out, their mortar glowing, then sink back: every enemy the ring passes under is struck and thrown into the air. The third wave is the strongest.
spell.arcanes_oublies.closing_keep.guide: A ring of eight crenellated walls builds itself all round the spot you look at, a great sigil burning inside it. Then every wall slides inwards at once, faster and faster, herding everything inside to the middle, where they meet: whatever is caught there is crushed, thrown up and dazed, and the walls burst into flying bricks.
spell.arcanes_oublies.great_rampart.guid: An immense crenellated wall, fifteen to twenty-three blocks wide, builds itself across your path. It sways and shudders, its mortar heating white-hot, then topples forward flat onto everything before it, as far as it is high: whatever it lands on is crushed, pinned down, slowed and weakened, and bricks burst all along where it fell.
spell.arcanes_oublies.siege.guide: Raise your hand for a second and a half and sound the siege: a great sigil burns over the zone you look at, then for five seconds blazing blocks of masonry come hurtling down out of the sky behind you, each landing on a sigil of its own, half of them aimed at the enemies in the zone. Each smashes everything around it and throws it up.
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.wall_burst: %1$s was blown away by %2$s's bursting wall
ritual.arcanes_oublies.meteor.desc: A meteor falls slowly out of the sky where the leader looks (up to 64 blocks) and strikes hostile creatures with fire.
ritual.arcanes_oublies.dome.desc: A dome of light 16 blocks wide shields the place for 5 minutes: hostile creatures cannot enter, their shots break on it, players under it resist damage.
ritual.arcanes_oublies.storm.desc: A storm gathers over the place for a minute; lightning strikes a hostile creature under it every second and a half.
ritual.arcanes_oublies.portal.desc: Opens for a minute a portal to the anchor marked with the leader's chalk, and one back.
ritual.arcanes_oublies.blessing.desc: Every player within 24 blocks is healed, cleansed and strengthened for 5 minutes (Regeneration, Absorption, Resistance, Strength).
ritual.arcanes_oublies.colossus.desc: A giant colossus wakes in the circle and fights for the group for 3 minutes.
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_howto: Sneak + use in the air: change ritual. Use on the ground: draw the circle. Kneel (sneak) on the stations to channel.
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_no_anchor: Mark the portal's anchor first (sneak + use on the ground)
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_too_close: Too close to another ritual circle
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_begins: The ritual begins: %s (%s seconds). Hold your places!
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_broken: The ritual is broken: a station was left empty
ui.arcanes_oublies.ritual_no_mana: The ritual is broken: %s has no mana left
spell.arcanes_oublies.ruby_ray.guide: Hold to pour a beam of red light out of a cut ruby turning before your hand. The beam goes through everything living on its way, burning it and setting it alight, and scorches where it ends. Aimed through one of your Diamond Prisms, it splits into three rays that seek the enemies around the prism.
spell.arcanes_oublies.ruby_heart.guide: Hurl a spinning ruby. It sets itself into the first enemy it strikes (or into the ground) and beats like a heart, three times, each beat hotter, scorching everything around; on the fourth it bursts in molten shards, burning and throwing back all around.
spell.arcanes_oublies.lapis_seal.guide: Four tablets of lapis rise out of the ground round the enemy you look at, golden runes burning on them, and bind it with chains of golden light. Sealed, it can neither cast nor move and the seal burns it; when its time is up the tablets break and the seal bursts on it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.lapis_constellatio: Seven stars of lapis, flecked with gold like the night sky, circle you on a tilted ring, joined by threads of golden light. When an enemy comes near, a star leaves the ring and darts at it; the figure closes up behind it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.diamond_prism.guid: A great cut diamond hovers over the spot you point at, turning slowly. Every second it refracts the light into rainbow rays that strike up to three enemies around it. Your Ruby Ray aimed through it is split into three rays. You can keep two prisms at a time.
spell.arcanes_oublies.diamond_shell.guid: Twelve plates of cut diamond close round you in a turning shell. Each blow that reaches you loses most of its strength on a plate, and the plate breaks off and flies back at whoever struck. When its time is up, what is left of the shell bursts out in shards at the enemies around.
spell.arcanes_oublies.amethyst_resonance: Clusters of amethyst burst out of the ground in a ring round you and ring together, three times, each note higher. Each time a wave of sound rolls out across the ground: it hurts and dazes the enemies it passes and shatters the enemy shots it meets.
spell.arcanes_oublies.amethyst_geode.gui: A geode closes round the enemy you look at, layer on layer as real geodes grow (smooth basalt, calcite, amethyst), open on your side like a geode cut in half. Amethyst crystals grow inward and pierce it again and again while it is held; then the geode cracks open and bursts.
spell.arcanes_oublies.emerald_bloom.guid: A flower of emeralds opens on the ground at your feet, six cut emeralds for petals round a great one floating at its heart. Every second it heals you and your allies around and takes one ailment off each; when it fades its petals burst into green light that leaves you all regenerating and shielded.
spell.arcanes_oublies.crown_of_gems.guid: Channel while a pentagram draws itself on the ground in the five colours. Five great gems rise round you at its points, and for eight seconds each does what it is: the ruby burns the nearest enemy, the lapis seals one, the diamond hardens your side, the amethyst rings out, the emerald heals. Then the five spiral up and fuse into one prismatic gem that strikes the spot you aimed at with a ray of every colour, blowing everything there away.
ui.arcanes_oublies.splits_ruby_ray: Splits the Ruby Ray in Three

ui.arcanes_oublies.cleanses: Takes One Ailment Off Each Second

ui.arcanes_oublies.midas_coats: Each Coat of Gold Brings the Statue Closer
ui.arcanes_oublies.armor_gilds: Gilds Those Who Strike You Hand to Hand
spell.arcanes_oublies.time_loop.guide: Closes a loop three seconds long round the enemy you look at. Ghosts of it mark its path through each loop; when the loop closes, a dial behind its head whirls back, a stream of time carries it back to where it stood when the loop closed, and the blows it took meanwhile strike it again.
spell.arcanes_oublies.captive_orbit.guid: A small planet appears over the enemy you look at, and the enemy is torn off the ground and swept into orbit round it, faster and faster, struck at each turn. Cast again to sling it out of orbit where you look: it flies off like a meteor and crashes into whatever it meets, hurting what is round it. Left alone, it is flung off when the planet fades.
spell.arcanes_oublies.comet_ride.guide: A comet streaks down under you and carries you off: an icy nucleus in a glowing coma, a long blue tail streaming behind. It never stops, goes where you look and rams whatever is in its way. Cast again (or jump off) and it dives: it crashes where it is headed in a blast all round, leaving a crater of burning ground, and throws you clear to float down.
spell.arcanes_oublies.pocket_moon.guide: A little moon goes into orbit round you, waxing and waning as it goes round. It strikes what it passes through and throws it aside, and its tide draws foes in toward you, into its path. Each time you cast again you throw it where you look like a boomerang: it strikes all along the way, there and back, then goes back into orbit.
spell.arcanes_oublies.living_constellati: You raise a hand to the sky and the stars of Leo come down one by one and join into a great lion of starlight: a star at each joint, lines of light between them, a mane of rays and a body of blue nebula. It fights at your side: it swipes with its claws and leaps on prey further off, landing in a burst of stars that strikes all round. Cast again to send it back to the sky.
spell.arcanes_oublies.asteroid_belt.guid: A ring of tumbling asteroids gathers round the spot you aim at and goes round it, a cage of rock: what crosses it is struck and thrown back inside, and enemy shots that meet it are smashed. Cast again (or wait for its end) and the belt falls in on itself: the rocks whirl faster as they close in, heat red then orange, drag everything inside to the middle and crash together there, crushing it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.zero_gravity.guide: A dome of zero gravity opens round you, faintly starlit. Enemies inside lose their weight and drift helplessly up off the ground, and their shots slow down and hang in the air. You and your allies keep a moon's gravity: great bounding leaps and soft landings. Cast again (or wait for it to fail) and gravity comes back all at once: everything that floated is slammed into the ground, the higher the harder.
spell.arcanes_oublies.black_hole.guide: A black hole opens over the spot you aim at: a sphere of nothing ringed with light, its accretion disk whirling white-hot round it and bent over and under it by its pull. Everything that is not yours drifts in, faster and faster as it nears, and is torn at near the horizon; enemy shots are swallowed. Cast again (or wait for its end) and it collapses to a point and bursts, throwing everything back out with two jets of light shooting up and down.
spell.arcanes_oublies.reset_charge.guide: You set a TVA reset charge on the ground where you aim. It counts down five seconds, beeping louder each second (cast again to set it off at once), then resets the timeline all round: you and your allies come back as you were at your best those five seconds, rid of what ails you; enemies are struck, sent back to where they stood five seconds before and dazed, and the weakest are pruned from time altogether.
ui.arcanes_oublies.reset_allies: Allies Back as They Were %s Ago
death.attack.cosmos_magic.item: %1$s was pruned from time by %2$s using %3$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.bone_lance.guide: A long bone spear grows out of your hand, sharpened to a barbed point, and you hurl it. It runs through up to three enemies, leaving each bleeding marrow and slowed, and splinters where it lands.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bone_spikes.guide: You strike the ground and a line of bone spikes bursts out of it one after another, running out ahead of you, taller and taller as it goes. Every enemy a spike bursts up under is impaled: hurt, thrown up and slowed.
spell.arcanes_oublies.spine_whip.guide: A whip of vertebrae with a spike at its tip grows out of your hand and lashes round in front of you from right to left, its far end trailing like a real whip. Whatever it sweeps through is struck and flung aside.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bone_volley.guide: A spray of bone splinters bursts from your hand and fans out ahead of you. Each splinter that strikes an enemy stops in it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bone_ward.guide: Shoulder blades of bone circle round you for twenty seconds. While any are left you take less damage; a shot that comes near is smashed by a plate, and a blow struck from close by is half turned aside, the attacker torn by the splinters. Each plate breaks after one save.
spell.arcanes_oublies.rib_cage.guide: Great ribs burst out of the ground on both sides of the enemy you look at and curve over it until they lock above, a spine along the top. Held fast inside, it is ground by the ribs every second, until they snap shut on it and crumble.
spell.arcanes_oublies.ossuary.guide: The ground where you look becomes an ossuary: for several seconds spikes of bone burst out all over the circle, two every tick, impaling and throwing up whatever stands there, and the ground drags at the feet of every enemy in it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.skeletal_grasp.gui: A giant hand of bone bursts out of the ground under the enemy you look at, its forearm after it. It closes into a fist round its prey, lifts it high and crushes it, then drives it down into the ground with a quake that throws back everything around, and sinks back.
spell.arcanes_oublies.bone_wyrm.guide: A great serpent of vertebrae with a skull for a head bursts out of the ground before you and hunts: it rises over its prey and dives through it, rebounds and turns on the next, coiling round you when there is nothing left to hunt. When its time is up it dives back into the ground.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gashadokuro.guide: Channel for a second and a half: a giant skeleton rises out of the ground behind you, waist-deep, a skull as big as a man, eyes burning crimson, and roars. For its time it smashes its fists down on your enemies, one arm then the other, each blow shaking the ground all round; then it sinks back.
